title: AI Backtester
author: BacktestTrader
selftext:
Recently started working on a project to do with backtesting your own strategy. The way it works is:   
  
You will paste a screenshot of your own strategy into the system with some plain english text explaining your strategy, AI will backtest over a certain number of years and output all results and feeback.   
  
Theres a lot more to it but I have just summarised it as im looking to see if this could be a valueable piece of software or am I wasting my time developing this. All feedback is appreciated.
